description: Dreneringslinjer Frogn kommune is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Frogn kommune. Its keywords include Frogn kommune, Samfunnssikkerhet, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2024-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
